questions.question: 2025年设备实际运行小时数的合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM("actual_run_hours") FROM "fact_equipment_runtime" WHERE substr("record_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 2025年报价单的单价平均是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG("unit_price") FROM "fact_quotation" WHERE substr("quotation_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 2026年产品等级为一等品的产出记录一共有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_production_output" WHERE substr("output_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "grade" = '一等品'

questions.question: PA挤出2线的蒸汽合计是多少吨？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."steam_tons") FROM "fact_energy_consumption" f JOIN "dim_production_line" p ON f."line_id" = p."line_id" WHERE p."line_name" = 'PA挤出2线'

questions.question: 有多少个安全计划的状态是“closed”？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_safety_plan" WHERE "status" = 'closed'
